note: Calhoun County, AR: county GIS site (gis.calhouncounty.org) offers only parcel, flood and school-district viewers, no zoning layer. Hampton and Thornton city sites show no zoning GIS. The ArcGIS search for zoning in the county found nothing. Arkansas counties generally do not zone; Hampton and Thornton have overlay-district listings in the state City Street archive but no published zoning polygons or service.
